labels.m0: M0, number concentration (column 'M0 best Diameter', as tabulated)
labels.mpass3: MPASS third moment (offset and dilution corrected; no unit in header) — mass/volume-type signal
labels.dusttrak_b_mg_m3: DustTrak B, light-scattering mass (mg/m³, calibrated, dilution-corrected)

aggregation: median over SAME and SAME-R flight tests with M0 > 0 and a DustTrak B value; rank 1 = largest
dust_note: DAFT diameters are mass/number-equivalent diameters (diameter of average mass) computed in the source workbook from DustTrak mass / P-Trak number with density 1.0 g/cm3; the SAME/SAME-R sheet's 'Diameter of Average mass' is the same definition, but its assumed particle density is not stated in the sheet. Count-mean diameters (M1/M0) are a different definition.
alarm_note: The SAME/SAME-R workbook gives detector scatter voltages but no alarm thresholds or alarm states, so no alarm result is stated.
